description: List the war.app game-update pushes this server process has received (newest first): which game changed and when. Only games watched by warapp_wait_for_turn are listened to; a push says only that a game changed, so re-read it with warapp_get_game. Also reports whether the push socket is connected and its transport (websocket or xhr-polling). Read-only.
name: warapp_recent_events
title: Recent war.app push events
